name: Kusatsu (Gunma, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kusatsu town emblem in white: a broken ring of dashed arcs enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Kusatsu, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 March 1988.

features.role: Kusatsu town emblem — a broken ring of dashed arcs enclosing three vertical bars
